name: post-cortex
description: Long-term project memory for Claude Code: the post-cortex MCP server (cloud by default, or your own daemon), the post-cortex-memory skill, and hooks that keep the memory in front of every session.

url.title: post-cortex URL
url.description: Base URL of the post-cortex server, without a trailing slash. Keep the default for post-cortex cloud; for a self-hosted daemon use e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3737.

api_key.title: post-cortex API key
api_key.description: Bearer token for the server: your post-cortex cloud API key, or the auth_token of your own daemon. Leave empty for a local daemon without auth_token.
